newsitem.title: USA: U.S. reserve assets fell to $67.814 bln in June.
newsitem.headline: U.S. reserve assets fell to $67.814 bln in June.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Tuesday that U.S. reserve assets fell $240 million in June to $67.814 billion from $68.054 billion in May.
The department said U.S. holdings of foreign currencies fell slightly to $32.935 billion from $32.991 billion in May.
Gold stock totaled $11.05 billion in both months.
Special Drawing Rights with the International Monetary Fund fell to $10.02 billion in June from $10.05 billion.
The value of the U.S. reserve position with the IMF was down to $13.81 billion in June from $13.96 billion in May.
